description: What the seller keeps after eBay fees and a verdict (worth it / thin / pass) for an expected sale price and what the user would pay. Pure arithmetic in the currency you give it, with eBay US fees: pass the sale price and the cost in the same currency (the one price_item named in price.currency). For a seller on eBay UK, the worthIt block price_item returns already uses their own fees. Use price_item first when the sale price is unknown.

cost.description: What the user would pay for the item, in the same currency as expected_sale_price.

expected_sale_price.description: Expected eBay sale price, in the same currency as cost.

name: worth_it
title: Worth buying at this cost?
